title: Image Squeeze
compressImages: Image Squeeze: compress images in the workspace
losslessTip: Use lossless WebP: smaller savings than lossy, but the image is fully preserved; it does not help JPEG sources, where recording every compression artifact makes the file larger
methodTip: WebP encoding effort 0 to 6; higher gives smaller files but takes longer
oxipngLevelTip: oxipng optimisation level 1 to 6; higher gives smaller files but takes longer, level 4 or below is recommended
progressiveTip: Progressive JPEG: shows a blurred image first, then refines it
mozjpegQualityTip: MozJPEG re-encoding quality: higher keeps more detail and produces larger files
maxDimensionTip: Maximum edge length in pixels, 0 keeps the original size; only applies when converting to WebP
verifyTip: Check whether the old paths are still referenced after rewriting
deleteUnreferencedTip: Unreferenced assets have no references to rewrite, so the original file is removed after conversion instead of leaving another copy behind
notScanned: Click Scan to find compressible images
noMatch: No image matches the current filter
reviewDone: All pending images have been handled
noticeNotWorthwhile: The result is not smaller, replacing is not recommended and has been skipped
noticeReferenced: Referenced ${0} times, accepted results will rewrite them
noticeUnreferenced: Unreferenced, the original file will be deleted when accepted
stillEncoding: The image is still being compressed, please wait
zoomHint: Click to view full screen, use arrow keys to compare
unavailableViews: ${0} database definitions are missing or have invalid IDs and were skipped, other images are unaffected
cleanupHint: Referenced originals are now unreferenced assets, clean them in Settings - Assets - Unreferenced assets
orphanHint: ${0} new files were not relinked and became unreferenced assets, clean them as well
leftovers: ${0} old paths still have references, please check
nothingSelected: Select images in the list first
readonly: Compressing images is not available in a read-only workspace or publish mode
lossless_not_effective_for_jpeg: JPEG is already lossy, lossless encoding makes it larger; use lossy instead
unexpected_output_format: The encoder returned an unexpected format
webp_encoding_unsupported: WebP encoding is not supported on this platform
